title: Rediscovered Time Capsule to be Featured at Viking Days Celebration
summary_en: As Augustana University embarked on the renovation and expansion of its Chapel of Reconciliation, the owl statue Hindsight, Insight, Foresight was moved from its long-time home outside of Morrison Commons for refurbishment.
